title: Diary of Master William Silence
html_source:
Dodgson Hamilton Madden, 1840-1928 was an Irish Unionist Party Member of Parliament (MP) in the United Kingdom Parliament and subsequently a Judge

Madden wrote several books on legal topics; but his best-known work is probably “The Diary of Master William Silence; a Study of Shakespeare and of Elizabethan Sport” (1897), an imaganitive reconstruction of the world of Shakespeare’s Falstaff.
